en: Intelligens. Natural. Artificial. Collective. (Venice Architecture Biennale 2025)
zh: 《Intelligens. Natural. Artificial. Collective.》（2025 威尼斯建筑双年展）
desc_en: The 19th Venice Architecture Biennale, curated by Carlo Ratti, whose 'Natural' intelligence strand and Arsenale section 'Matter Makes Sense' showed architectures grown with cyanobacteria, mycelium and biocementing bacteria.
desc_zh: 第 19 届威尼斯建筑双年展，由 Carlo Ratti 策展；其“自然智能”板块和军械库单元“Matter Makes Sense”展出了用蓝细菌、菌丝体和生物胶结细菌“长”出来的建筑。
